Onion Soup Mix
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 31, 2009 - 12:29am

Ingredients




2 ounces jar , (¼  ea.) instant beef bouillon
1/2 teaspoon Pepper
1 cup Dry minced onion
1/4 cup Onion powder
1/4 cup Parsley flakes
1/8 cup (2 TBS) onion salt

Preparation

1 Combine and mix well. Use 1/4 cup for each package. Place in individual foil packages and store them in an airtight container. 2 Makes 9 recipes ofpackage soup mix.
